```python
    unique_items = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:

            seen.add(item)
    return unique_items
```

```python
def merge_sorted(left, right):
    sorted_list = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            sorted_list.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            sorted_list.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    sorted_list.extend(left[i:])
    sorted_list.extend(right[j:])
    return sorted_list
```

```python
        return items
    k = k % len(items)
    return items[-k:] + items[:-k]
```
